outcome: Placental glucocorticoid receptor (GR) isoforms (GRaC, GR-P, GRaD, nuclear GR)
cohort: Pregnant Merino ewes at 138 days of gestation (term = 150 days) were divided into betamethasone and saline treatment groups.
finding: Betamethasone induced molecular changes in the sheep placenta within 48 hours, increasing markers of angiogenesis and decreasing markers of growth and proliferation in both sexes, but heightened the apoptotic response and increased placental diffusion barrier thickness (indicative of placental insufficiency) specifically in female placentae, possibly driven by higher expression of pro-apoptotic GR isoforms.
gest_age: 138 days of gestation at the time of intervention (term = 150 days)
